claim: CNN announces on social media that President Donald Trump dies from COVID-19.
justification: High-confidence evidence (confidence 0.90-1.00) establishes that President Donald Trump survived COVID-19, was discharged from Walter Reed Medical Center on October 5, 2020, and was alive and active on and after October 13, 2020, including holding a campaign rally on October 12, 2020, and participating in a town hall on October 15, 2020. Evidence that CNN announced Trump's death on social media has very low confidence (0.10) and is assessed as fabricated, with no credible corroboration; thus, the claim is refuted.
